messages:
sarah-cs: heads up — Acme Support ticket #4529: after model retrain last night embeddings+rerank quality dropped significantly; precision@10 down ~18% based on their evaluation, also 95th latency spiked from 120ms to 280ms. They want priority triage. attaching their eval sample: <link>

jamie-eng: Thanks @sarah-cs — can you paste a small repro sample here? any server-side changes? model version? quantization?

sarah-cs: customer says model pinned to rwd-embed-v2:2026-03-18, no quantization changes on their side. They are on Hosted API. Link to ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4529

leo-pm: adding for product prioritization. We need to decide: P1 live customer impact? does this block revenue? @sarah-cs

sarah-cs: They reported regression on several critical search flows; revenue impact possible for Q2 renewal. Customer asks for ETA and mitigation.

olivia-ml: initial thought: if embedding vector distribution shifted after retrain, reranker could be affected. Need to compare embedding centroids and recall/precision curves. Also check KV cache miss patterns — increased cold misses could explain latency.

jamie-eng: Can eng run quick perf run on same model + request patterns? I can spin up a dedicated job. Command to run: 
```
python infra/tools/run_embed_bench.py --model rwd-embed-v2:2026-03-18 --dataset customersample.json --metrics recall,latency
```

deploy-bot: deployment update: rwd-embed-v2:2026-03-18 deployed to hosted-prod 2026-03-18T02:14Z by auto-deploy

leo-pm: Propose triage plan: (1) urgent mitigation: enable soft-fallback to rwd-embed-v1 for this customer via routing rule (2h work), (2) medium: reproduction + root cause (2-4d), (3) long: model onboarding checklist updates and automated eval gating (2w). Thoughts?

olivia-ml: Agree. add acceptance criteria: mitigation reduces precision drop <5% and P95 latency back under 160ms. Also need regression test added in model registry.

jamie-eng: I can do routing rule and perf run today. If we do fallback, need customer opt-in. @sarah-cs can you check if Acme is ok with temporary fallback?

sarah-cs: I'll call them now. Also sharing small eval sample in thread: https://s3.redwood/triage/acme/sample.json

andrew-support: FYI created internal triage ticket TRIAGE-1098 and flagged as customer escalated. Linking to CS ticket.

leo-pm: ok assign owners: eng=jamie, ml=olivia, cs=sarah, product=leo. I'll file a product request to prioritize on roadmap if impact confirmed. Deadline for initial mitigation: EOD today. Update in this thread pls.

sarah-cs: update — customer approved temporary fallback. proceeding.

jamie-eng: routing rule created: route Acme org id -> rwd-embed-v1 for matching traffic. Rolling out in 10m. I'll post logs when done.

jamie-eng: rollback done, perf quick-check: p95 lat 148ms, precision delta reduced to 3.2%. Posting artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/embed/tris/1098

leo-pm: great. marking as mitigated. Next steps: confirm RCA and decide whether to revert model or retrain. Meeting 3pm today to scope roadmap work.

olivia-ml: I'll start embedding distribution analysis and propose remediation options (recalibration, re-indexing, or retrain with more negative examples).

sarah-cs: thanks all. closing loop with customer and scheduling weekly check-ins until fully resolved. :thumbsup:
